roughness.definition: Areal Sa/Sq relative to the mean plane; Sz is sampled peak-to-valley, not PNG encoding range.

model: Existing scalar phase-screen; uniform normal incidence, n_out=1, acceptance 2.5deg. No change to surface; no new native backend runs.
scope: D65/V-weighted illustrative surface-model ratio over 380-780nm. The 380-780 range is truncated; no measured source, substrate identification, angle-dependent Fresnel, instrument corrections or actual standard luminous-haze claim. N-BK7 is an illustrative dispersion example, not identification of the paper glass.
transmitted_power_weight: Q(lambda)=normal-incidence flat-interface Fresnel power T0(n(lambda))*represented_scalar_forward_flux. It is an explicit approximate weight, not measured absolute transmission. Integrate D65*V*Q*H / D65*V*Q using trapezoidal quadrature.

execution_context.device: CPU; no new native GPU solves
